messages.text: Production operations needs one defensible decision for maintenance operation requiring electrical qualification by 2026-01-19; a faster or broader action has value only if it remains inside shop qualification, active status, tooling, and capacity must all pass.
I found 46 HR on the header, but the workbook has separate observation and exclusion rows. Please do not net from this message.

Approval AP-0023 permits one control-compliant action on NS-000023 up to 19 HR, provided shop qualification, active status, tooling, and capacity must all pass. It does not select an option in advance and does not authorize broader records or send_to_unqualified_fast_shop.
Protected load remains non-displaceable. The calendar for internal electrical-shop load is the source for internal windows; the supplier response covers only its stated alternative.
Revision R10 and the CASE-024 record are visible in search but are not applicable to CASE-023.

Required closeout records: record the selected option, committed completion, and binding constraint in the existing Control outcome cell; and post the decided option, date, constraint, alternatives, and Oracle reference in the existing operations thread. Verify the persisted record after the Oracle call.
